CREATE VIEW [DW].[ViewRBBDeposit_Retail]
AS WITH BusinessDate AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
MIN(BusinessDateSK) As BusinessDateSk
FROM (
    SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) BusinessDateSk FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance FDOB
) a )

SELECT DISTINCT
(SELECT Businessdatesk FROM BusinessDate) AS BusinessDateSk
,DCA.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,DCA.CustomerID AS CustomerID
,DCA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DCA.AccountID AS AccountID
,DDA.AccountName AS AccountName
,DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDAH.AccountHolderTypeName AS AccountHolderType
,DDA.AccountStatus AS AccountStatus
,DDA.ProfitCostCode AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BranchName AS BranchName  
,DDB.Area AS Area
,DDB.Region AS Region
,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName AS ProductName
,NULL AS BalanceAmountFull_Original
,NULL AS BalanceAmountProrated_Original
,NULL AS PesoConversionRate
,NULL AS Currency_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,FDOB.BalanceAmountFull AS BalanceAmountFull
,FDOB.BalanceAmountProrated AS BalanceAmountProrated
FROM  DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountName,AccountStatus,ProfitCostCode,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP')  DDA ON DCA.AccountSK = DDA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountHolderTypeName, AccountHolderTypeSk FROM DW.DimAccountHolderType --WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
) DDAH ON DCA.AccountHolderTypeSK = DDAH.AccountHolderTypeSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchName,Area,Region,BranchSk FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DDB ON DCA.BranchSk = DDB.BranchSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK, ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') DDAP ON DCA.AccountSk = DDAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductGroup, ProductName, ProductSk FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1) DP ON DDAP.ProductSk = DP.ProductSk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK,AccountSk,BalanceAmountFull,BalanceAmountProrated FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate)) FDOB ON  DCA.AccountSk = FDOB.Accountsk
WHERE (FDOB.BusinessDateSK = (SELECT BusinessDatesk from BusinessDate) OR FDOB.BusinessDateSK IS NULL)
AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND DCA.CustomerSK IN (Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.dimcustomer
                        where currentindicator =1 
                        and customertype = 'Retail');
GO
